name: distortionz_towjob
changelog: v1.2.1 — Pre-release patch pass. FIXED: clockOff handler crashed with 'attempt to call a nil value (global CleanupAllPlacedObjects)' because the function was a local declared further down the file than the closure that referenced it; lexical scoping meant the closure couldn't see it. Resolved with forward declarations at the top of client.lua for both CleanupAllPlacedObjects and SetSpawnerNuiOpen. Side effect: HUD now actually hides on clock-off (the crash was preventing HudHide() from ever running). FIXED: stale HUD lingering after a reconnect or character switch — added ResetClientState() helper that runs at resource boot AND on three player-loaded events (playerSpawned / QBCore:Client:OnPlayerLoaded / qbx_core:client:playerLoaded) so the HUD never haunts the screen after the Lua state resets. ADDED: per-vehicle attach offsets — Config.Attach.modelOverrides table with 13 educated-guess entries for tall SUVs/pickups (cavalcade, granger, baller, bobcatxl), small/sports cars (blista, panto, dilettante, felon, sentinel, fugitive), and wagons (ingot, stratum). Workflow: spot a misaligned car → add an entry with adjusted z → restart. ADDED: README.md with installation, dependencies, configuration highlights, audio asset guide, spawn-pool tips, and credits. ADDED: f550rollback bundle credit — README + CREDITS.txt in the addon folder properly attributing Scorpionfam (original author of [NON-ELS][ELS][Addon][FiveM-Ready] F550 Rollback v1.1.0 on lcpdfr.com). The script's MIT license does not extend to the bundled vehicle asset. v1.2.0 — Major feature pass. ADDED: /towjob equipment spawner — premium centred catalog UI, 8 props (cones small/large/highway, reflective triangle, road flare, work + long barriers, construction sign), raycast preview that follows camera with Q/E rotate, LMB to confirm / RMB to abort, networked spawn so other players see the placements, ox_target 'Pack up' on every placed item, 12-item per-player cap, auto cleanup on clock-off / resource stop. ADDED: 46 dispatch reasons across 5 categories (parking violations, mechanical breakdowns, accidents, owner-related, miscellaneous) — picked at random per call so dispatches never feel repetitive. ADDED: dispatch audio — radio chirp open/close (ogg/mp3/wav supported, drop in html/sounds/) plus browser SpeechSynthesis voice-over with configurable rate/pitch/volume/preferred-voice and substitution template. ADDED: hazard lights on towed vehicle — per-frame indicator tick fires both turn signals while the car is hooked, plus engine-on at attach time so the electrical system actually powers the lights, plus forced taillights for night visibility. ADDED: brand footer in HUD — 'Distortionz Tow Job' + live version + GitHub link, visible in both Standing By and Active Call states. ADDED: drop-off blip switching — once the player hooks a car, the call-spot blip is replaced with a fresh GPS route to the yard dropoff. ADDED: re-request flatbed flow — context-aware ox_target options on the dispatcher ped (Clock on / Request flatbed / Clock off), each shown only when applicable. ADDED: ground-snap for placed props — preview snaps to ground every frame, final spawn always snaps before optional freeze. ADDED: Config.Attach with maxDistance + offset for tunable attach behaviour. ADDED: Config.Spawner with command/cooldown/cap/catalog. CHANGED: flatbed model to f550rollback (matches new vehicle addon). CHANGED: spawn pool labels — refined coords + plain place names so dispatch location and reason fields don't conflict (e.g. label 'Strawberry alley' instead of 'Strawberry — fire hydrant blocked'). CHANGED: cones now freeze on placement so vehicles bump but don't displace them. CHANGED: HUD positioned at top:30% right side, clear of notify (top-right) + textUI (right-center). CHANGED: flatbed spawns 100% clean — zero dirt, decals washed, full engine/body/petrol-tank health, deformation reset. FIXED: vehicle keys missing on flatbed spawn — server-side qbx_vehiclekeys.GiveKeys now polls up to 2s for entity replication + populated plate before granting. FIXED: invalid prop models in spawner catalog (prop_warning_tri_01 was prop_warningtri_01, prop_mc_signage_03 didn't exist — replaced with prop_consign_01a). FIXED: pre-flight model validity check (IsModelInCdimage + IsModelValid) so a typo in Config.Spawner.items shows a clean notification instead of crashing requestModel. INTERNAL: split distortionz_calmaiadvance threads (separate world-flag/relationship bootstrap from per-ped scan, removed broken SetAmbientVehicleRangeMultiplierThisFrame call). v1.0.0 — Initial release: tow operator job, Beeker's Garage yard, dispatch calls every 60s, payout = base + per-km bonus - damage penalty, NUI HUD, distortionz_notify wrapper, version_check.lua, qbx_core SetJob integration.
